description:
Read or drive the assessment (graded quiz) on the current slide by pressing the same buttons a learner would.

Without 'action': returns the assessment state. With 'action': presses that button, waits for the assessment to update, and returns the new state.

State: {id, view ('intro' | 'question' | 'review' | 'results'), questionIndex, question ({id, type, hasResponse} while a question shows), actions (buttons available now), modalOpen, attempts, lastResults}

Typical run:
1. coursecode_navigate to the assessment slide
2. action 'start'
3. For each question: coursecode_interact with question.id from this state, then action 'next'
4. On the review screen: action 'submit' (if an unanswered-questions dialog opens, use 'confirm-unanswered-submit' or 'dismiss-unanswered-modal')
5. Read lastResults here and the LMS score/success in coursecode_state

Other actions: 'prev', 'jump-to-review', 'review-question' (with questionIndex), 'back-to-questions', 'retake', 'go-to-remedial', 'restart-course'. An unavailable action returns an error listing the available ones.

Requires preview server to be running.

action.description: Button to press. Omit to read the current assessment state.

name: coursecode_assessment
